title: Substation (asset overlay)
description: Phase 5a asset overlay kind. A substation site: the top-level record its busbar sections, switching devices, earth paths and three-winding transformers sit under. Carried beside the model, never used by the solver: the authored buses stay the electrical truth. A substation points at no element itself; its busbar sections point at the buses they collapse to.

name.description: The site name as the operator publishes it.

operator.description: The owner or operator of the site.
